changelog: Virtual TV 2.0.1.0 is the consolidated hotfix for the 2.0 release. It includes Standard TV quality selection, Clone Channel, Android TV compatibility/visibility handling, administration UI improvements, and the validated Jellyfin for Android phone/tablet Personalized TV WebView handoff so Loading opens the selected item through Jellyfin's normal local playback path.
